compass.title: Frontier Compass

scales.title: Magistrate's Scales

national-ledger.title: The National Ledger

seal.title: Registrar’s Seal
seal.text: The first records reconcile. GDP, income, expenditure, CPI, inflation, and real values can now be separated from false measures.

prism.title: The Warden’s Prism
prism.text: Growth now splits into its true sources. Productivity, capital, human capital, natural resources, technology, and policy can be read without distortion.

crown.title: The Comptroller’s Crown
crown.text: The labor record is restored. Employment, unemployment, participation, job search, mismatch, policy effects, and the natural rate now balance in the ledger.

stabilization-protocol.title: The Stabilization Protocol

policyKey.title: The Policy Key
policyKey.text: The Policy Key unlocks the first layer of the Protocol: money, reserves, Fed tools, interest-rate control, and the policy channels that move through the economy.

regentSeal.title: The Regent’s Seal
regentSeal.text: The Regent’s Seal marks command over stabilization tradeoffs: AD-AS shocks, liquidity preference, fiscal and monetary policy, multiplier effects, crowding out, expectations, and the risks of trying to force balance.

chancellorsMandate.title: The Custodian’s Mandate
chancellorsMandate.text: The Custodian’s Mandate restores final authority over the Protocol: inflation, unemployment, Phillips-curve tradeoffs, expectations, disinflation, sacrifice ratios, and full policy judgment.
